pr_title: ILM: execute cached steps even if policy is updated
pr_body:
This makes ILM honour the cached phase even when the underlying policy
is updated to not contain the cached actions.

Fixes #66838

issue_context.title: ILM can get stuck in the hot phase during attempt-rollover step if rollover is removed from the policy

review_comments: Exposed this here for convenience and to reduce the number of dependencies `IndexLifecycleTransition` would need if it was to use the `PhaseCacheManagement` directly.
